源自 2152; TDNT - 7:175,1010; 動詞

欽定本 - worship 1, show piety 1; 2

from 2152; TDNT - 7:175,1010; v

AV - worship 1, show piety 1; 2

1) to act piously or reverently

       whom dutiful regard or reverence is due
